items.title: Africa: Ethiopia Becomes Africa's Fifth-Largest Economy After Rebasing GDP
items.description: [Daba Finance] Ethiopia has become Africa's fifth-largest economy after revising its gross domestic product figures to account for sectors including digital finance, services and manufacturing.
